match.userMessage: A serene watercolor mountain landscape at golden hour, soft brushstrokes.

image.revisedPrompt: Craft a serene watercolor painting depicting a mountain landscape at golden hour. These numerous, towering mountains should be highlighted by the enchanting oranges and purples of the setting sun. The scene should seem almost softly blurred, the result of gentle brushstrokes carefully applied to the paper, imbuing each element of the landscape with an otherworldly, peaceful atmosphere. The overall art should evoke a sense of tranquility and peace as one would witness during a quiet golden-hour in the mountains.
